purpose: Teach: 於け/探訪/無実/乞う/絶た/幾多/慶応/変調

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時下に於ける学術の状況を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the state of academia during wartime, didn't you?
lines.style: Measured, professional tone. Warm but observant. She's genuinely interested, not testing. Slight pause before the question, as if reviewing notes.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、伝統工芸の里の探訪記事を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I explored the subject of a visit to a traditional craft village in my paper.
lines.style: Straightforward and sincere. A touch nervous — clarifying what he actually wrote. Careful not to overstate. Eyes briefly meet hers before looking down slightly.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、冤罪、つまり無実の罪の事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you addressed the topic of wrongful conviction — false accusation — in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle, thoughtful delivery. She's testing the waters, curious about his choice of difficult subject matter. Slower pace. Slightly softer on the definition, as if ensuring understanding.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、被害者ご家族が支援を乞う声明を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I focused on statements from victims' families seeking support in my paper.
lines.style: Quiet, serious. He's not performing — this subject matters to him. Direct. A slight tremor of care in his voice, quickly steadied.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時下で連絡が絶たれた記録を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper dealt with records of severed communication during wartime, didn't it?
lines.style: Reflective and careful. She's piecing something together about him. Slight tilt of her head. Warm but probing — not accusing, understanding.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、明治期の幾多の苦難の記録を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I examined records of the many hardships endured during the Meiji period in my paper.
lines.style: Controlled but earnest. There's a pattern he's aware of — his topics all touch something deep. He's explaining, not defending. Voice steady but slightly quieter.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、慶応年間の社会変動の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote about social transformation during the Keio era, didn't you?
lines.style: The same gentle, reflective tone, but now with a hint of recognition. She's understood something about him. Slower, more deliberate. A teacher who sees her student clearly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、患者の体調変調の医療記録を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I focused on medical records documenting changes in a patient's condition in my paper.
lines.style: Quiet and honest. He knows what she's understood now. A small pause before answering — he's letting it land. Voice steady, almost resigned. Subtle closure at the end.
